events.body:
Parent work item: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-docs/-/work_items/1

This child work item is part of the BLT-docs redesign and platform documentation hub umbrella.

### Description

Modernize BLT-API documentation inside BLT-docs so it matches the current `/v2`, Cloudflare Workers, D1, route metadata, dashboard, API-key, and JWT direction.

### Scope

- Update `docs/repositories/blt-api.md`.
- Prefer `/v2` routes in examples.
- Document Cloudflare Workers Python runtime, D1 migrations, Wrangler, local dev, tests, API-key gate, JWT identity, route metadata, and dashboard usage.
- Link to the GitLab BLT-API repo and dashboard route once confirmed.
- Avoid changing `X-BLT-API-Key` semantics.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] BLT-API docs explain local setup, tests, Wrangler, D1 migrations, deployment, and route metadata.
- [ ] Auth docs separate `X-BLT-API-Key` gate from JWT/session identity.
- [ ] Route examples prefer `/v2/...`.
- [ ] Dashboard/docs UX is documented as the preferred API exploration path.
- [ ] No secrets or hard-coded live keys are added.
- [ ] Build passes with `uvx --with-requirements requirements.txt mkdocs build --strict`.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-docs/-/issues/5 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-04).
